# Physical AI Field Guide

> A vendor-neutral field guide to Physical AI: the companies, chips, and models building machines that perceive, reason, and act in the physical world. Every TOPS figure is a peak vendor claim at a stated precision (INT4, INT8, and FP4 are not comparable); independent benchmarks are flagged. Content last reviewed 2026-06-03. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

## Core pages

- [Overview](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/README.md): what Physical AI is, the two market vectors (edge specialists vs datacenter giants), and summary tables
- [Concepts](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/concepts/README.md): definition of Physical AI, cloud vs edge vs embedded, the three-computer workflow
- [Architecture philosophies](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/architecture-philosophies/README.md): SIMT GPU, heterogeneous NPU SoC, structural dataflow, digital and analog in-memory compute, deterministic LPU, RISC-V tensor grid
- [Hardware comparison](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/hardware-comparison/README.md): precision-labeled flagship specs, vendor vs independent benchmarks
- [VLA and world models](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/vla-and-world-models/README.md): RT-2, OpenVLA, pi0, SmolVLA, GR00T N1.5, NVIDIA Cosmos, LeRobot
- [Applications](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/applications/README.md): humanoids, AMRs, manufacturing, automotive, smart cities, healthcare
- [Future and market](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/future-and-market/README.md): growth thesis and sourced market-size ranges
- [Renames and deprecations](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-embedded-ai-stack/blob/main/renames-and-deprecations.md): Groq to NVIDIA, Coral abandoned, TensorFlow Lite to LiteRT, and other 2024-2026 changes

- [Hardware and runtime picker](https://premchand006.github.io/awesome-physical-ai/docs/picker/): interactive tool to choose an edge-AI accelerator or runtime by budget, use case, power, and ecosystem

## Company profiles

- [Company index](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/README.md): master landscape comparison table
- [NVIDIA](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/nvidia.md): CUDA + Jetson (SIMT GPU)
- [Intel](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/intel.md): OpenVINO (CPU / NPU / GPU)
- [Qualcomm](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/qualcomm.md): AI Hub (Hexagon NPU)
- [Hailo](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/hailo.md): structural dataflow NPU
- [SiMa.ai](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/sima-ai.md): Palette (MLSoC)
- [Axelera](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/axelera.md): Voyager SDK (digital in-memory compute)
- [Blaize](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/blaize.md): Graph Streaming Processor
- [DeepX](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/deepx.md): DXNN (heterogeneous NPU)
- [MemryX](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/memryx.md): at-memory dataflow, open SDK
- [Mythic](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/mythic.md): analog compute-in-memory
- [EnCharge](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/encharge.md): analog charge-domain in-memory compute
- [Ambarella](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/ambarella.md): CVflow vision SoC
- [Groq and Tenstorrent](https://github.com/Premchand006/awesome-physical-ai/blob/main/companies/datacenter-context.md): datacenter context
